features.title: Projected and rated range
features.description: Shows both projected range (based on recent driving efficiency) and rated range (EPA/WLTP estimate) so drivers can compare real-world consumption against the official rating on the instrument cluster and energy displays.

features.title: Entry / Exit feature – Displays on and Media auto play for entry and decrease volume upon exit
features.description: Automatically wakes the displays and can resume media when you enter the car, then lowers media volume when you exit—an early welcome/leave behavior for the Model S cabin experience.

features.title: Driver profiles (up to 10 can be saved)
features.description: Saves personalized seat, mirror, steering, and preference settings under named driver profiles. Early Model S software allowed up to 10 profiles so multiple drivers could restore their setup quickly.

features.title: Creep mode (emulate automatic transmission idle forward)
features.description: Optional creep that gently rolls the car forward when Drive is selected and the brake is released, mimicking a conventional automatic transmission at idle for low-speed parking-lot feel.

features.title: Traffic lines in map
features.description: Adds live traffic flow coloring on the navigation map so congested roads stand out while routing—an early traffic visualization layer on the Model S touchscreen map.

features.title: Higher volume granularity
features.description: Increases the number of discrete volume steps on the media system (beyond the earlier coarse 1–11 scale) so drivers can fine-tune cabin audio more precisely.

features.title: Lock and Unlock touch screen buttons separated for ease of use
features.description: Splits lock and unlock into separate on-screen controls instead of a single combined control, making it harder to tap the wrong action on the center display.

features.title: Mobile App Remote Access
features.description: Enables remote vehicle status and basic controls from the Tesla smartphone app (lock/unlock, climate, charging, and location), extending the cabin UI with phone-side access over the cellular connection.

features.title: Cancel button to nav
features.description: Adds an explicit cancel control to end an active navigation route from the map UI without digging through menus.

features.title: Vehicle sleep mode (reduced vampire drain)
features.description: Powers down the displays and non-essential electronics when parked to cut vampire drain. Tesla noted that leaving systems awake could cost on the order of ~8 miles of range per day when unplugged.

features.title: App launcher
features.description: Introduces an app launcher so owners can open cabin apps and choose whether they appear in the upper or lower half of the 17" touchscreen via drag-and-drop placement.

features.title: Voice commands
features.description: Hands-free voice control via the steering-wheel button for navigation (“drive to”), phone calls (“call”), and streaming audio (“listen” / play artist radio), using cloud speech recognition over the car’s modem.

features.title: Auto present door handles
features.description: Automatically presents the flush door handles when you approach with a paired key fob, so you no longer need to press the handle to deploy it before opening the door.

features.title: Vehicle alarm
features.description: Adds a vehicle alarm that can sound and alert when unauthorized entry or tampering is detected, extending Model S security beyond simple lock status.

features.title: Ability to switch between metric and imperial units
features.description: Lets owners choose metric or imperial units for speed, distance, temperature, and related displays so the UI matches regional preferences.

features.title: Range mode
features.description: An efficiency-focused driving mode that limits energy-hungry systems (climate aggressiveness and related draws) to stretch remaining range when you need every mile.

features.title: USB sorting for media
features.description: Improves browsing of USB music libraries with clearer sorting/indexing so large collections of tracks and folders are easier to navigate on the media player.

features.title: Ability to call phone numbers from map screen
features.description: Lets you place a phone call directly from a map place card or listed number while navigating, bridging maps and Bluetooth phone calling.

features.title: Fan speed and sunroof controls to steering wheel controls
features.description: Allows the steering-wheel scroll wheels to adjust fan speed or sunroof position (in addition to volume/temperature), so climate and roof controls are reachable without leaving the wheel.

features.title: Location aware homelink
features.description: HomeLink garage/gate buttons become context-aware: the car preferentially offers the opener associated with your current location (for example home vs. another programmed site).

features.title: Scheduled charging mode
features.description: Schedule when the car should charge (for off-peak utility rates or departure readiness) instead of charging immediately when plugged in.

features.title: Supercharger locations to maps
features.description: Plots Tesla Supercharger sites on the in-car map so drivers can find DC fast charging along a route or nearby without a separate lookup.

features.title: Visited chargers to maps
features.description: Remembers chargers you have used and surfaces them on the map for quicker return visits and trip planning.

features.title: Battery charge limit slider (Standard and Max Range)
features.description: Adds a charge-limit control with Standard and Max Range (and finer limits over time) so owners can daily-charge below 100% to reduce battery stress while still topping up for long trips.

features.title: Contact sorting options
features.description: Adds sorting/indexing options for the phone contacts list on the touchscreen, making large Bluetooth address books easier to scan.

features.title: New defrost mode
features.description: Dedicated windshield/defrost climate mode that prioritizes clearing glass quickly in cold or humid conditions from the climate UI.

features.title: Battery support (will draw power from wall instead of battery for HVAC)
features.description: When plugged in, cabin HVAC can run from wall power instead of depleting the traction battery—useful for preconditioning or keeping climate on while charging.

features.title: Battery ability to heat from utility instead of itself
features.description: Allows battery heating/preconditioning to draw from grid/wall power when plugged in, preserving pack energy and preparing the battery for efficient charging or departure.

features.title: Wifi
features.description: Adds Wi‑Fi connectivity so the car can download software updates and stream media over a home or hotspot network instead of relying only on cellular data.

features.title: Tow mode
features.description: Transport/tow mode for flatbed towing: holds the parking brake appropriately and reduces risk of drivetrain damage when the vehicle must be moved with wheels free.

features.title: Screen cleaning mode
features.description: Locks out touch input and often raises brightness so you can wipe the center display without accidentally tapping controls.

features.title: Radio presets to steering wheel controls
features.description: Lets steering-wheel controls cycle radio presets so you can change stations without reaching for the touchscreen.

features.title: Tracking modes in map (north up or vehicle up)
features.description: Choose whether the map stays north-up or rotates with vehicle heading (heading-up), matching classic navigation preferences.

features.title: Current anomaly detection (auto reduce charging amp by 25% if problem is detected)
features.description: Monitors charging current for electrical anomalies and automatically reduces charge amperage (by ~25%) when a problem is detected to protect the wall circuit and vehicle charge equipment.

features.title: Wiper service mode
features.description: Moves the wipers to a service position so blades can be replaced safely without forcing the arms against the glass or hood.

features.title: TPMS reset option
features.description: Adds a tire-pressure monitoring system (TPMS) reset/relearn option after tire service or pressure changes so warnings clear correctly.

features.title: RDIO
features.description: Integrates Rdio streaming music in the cabin media player (later replaced by Spotify after Rdio shut down), bringing cloud playlists to the Model S over the car’s data connection.

features.title: Hill assist
features.description: Holds the vehicle briefly when starting on an incline so it does not roll backward before you apply throttle—helpful with strong regen and one-pedal driving habits.

features.title: Smart air suspension options (auto lower for highway speeds)
features.description: Automatically lowers air suspension at highway speeds for improved aero/efficiency and raises it again at lower speeds for comfort and clearance (on air-suspension cars).

features.title: Home and work locations
features.description: Save Home and Work as special destinations for one-tap navigation and later automatic navigation / calendar-aware routing.

features.title: Asian font support for media player
features.description: Adds Asian-language font support in the media player so track and artist metadata in Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and related scripts render correctly.

features.title: FOB reprogram/swap ability
features.description: Allows reprogramming or swapping key fobs from the vehicle UI so replacement or additional fobs can be paired without a service visit for simple swaps.

features.title: Slacker radio reset ability
features.description: Adds a reset control for Slacker Radio streaming when the service gets stuck, restoring playback without a full car reboot.

features.title: Traffic aware navigation
features.description: Navigation routing that accounts for live traffic when calculating ETA and suggesting alternate routes around congestion.

features.title: Calendar
features.description: In-car Calendar app that syncs upcoming events (with phone/account connectivity) so you can navigate to event locations and see schedule context on the touchscreen.

features.title: More power management options
features.description: Expands power-management settings that control how aggressively the car sleeps displays and background systems to balance vampire drain versus wake readiness.

features.title: Location based air suspension settings
features.description: Remembers preferred air-suspension ride heights for specific locations (driveways, steep approaches) and applies them automatically when you arrive.

features.title: Custom car name
features.description: Lets owners set a custom vehicle name shown in the car UI and mobile app instead of a generic Model S/X label.

features.title: International OSK (onscreen keyboard)
features.description: Expands the on-screen keyboard with additional international layouts and character sets for entering destinations and search text worldwide.

features.title: Trip energy prediction
features.description: Predicts energy use for the planned route and shows expected battery level at arrival, helping decide whether a Supercharger stop is needed.

features.title: TACC to AP1 cars
features.description: Brings Traffic-Aware Cruise Control to Autopilot Hardware 1 cars: adaptive cruise that matches traffic speed and can follow the car ahead using the forward radar/camera suite.

features.title: Auto high beam to AP1 cars
features.description: Automatically switches between high and low beams based on detected traffic and lighting conditions on Autopilot-equipped cars.

features.title: Forward collision warning to AP1 cars
features.description: Alerts the driver when a potential frontal collision is detected, giving time to brake or steer before Automatic Emergency Braking may intervene.

features.title: Energy option for battery display
features.description: Adds an energy (kWh/percentage) view alongside distance-based range so owners can monitor pack energy directly in the battery/energy display.

features.title: Smart preconditioning (auto warm your car based on habits)
features.description: Learns typical departure patterns and can automatically precondition the cabin (and battery when relevant) before you usually leave, so the car is ready without a manual app request.

features.title: Reverse lines in backup cam
features.description: Overlays parking guidance lines on the backup camera view to help judge trajectory and distance while reversing.

features.title: Parkview assist
features.description: Park Assist / Parkview uses ultrasonic sensors to chime and visualize nearby obstacles while parking at low speed.

features.title: Shuffle and repeat to media player
features.description: Adds long-requested shuffle and repeat controls to the cabin media player for USB and streaming libraries.

features.title: Factory reset option
features.description: Provides a factory reset that erases profiles, Wi‑Fi credentials, HomeLink, and other personal data—important before selling or transferring the vehicle.

features.title: Trip planner with routing via Superchargers
features.description: Plans long-distance routes with automatic Supercharger stops, charging time estimates, and arrival energy targets so cross-country trips are navigable in one plan.

features.title: Range assurance
features.description: Warns when your remaining range may not reach the entered destination (or next charger) and can suggest charging or a more conservative speed.

features.title: Valet mode
features.description: Locks the glovebox/frunk, limits top speed and acceleration, hides destination/home data, and requires a PIN to exit—so you can hand the car to a valet with reduced access.

features.title: Blind spot warning
features.description: Warns when a vehicle is detected in the blind spot during lane changes, using Autopilot sensors to reduce side-collision risk.

features.title: AEB (auto emergency braking)
features.description: Automatic Emergency Braking applies the brakes if a frontal collision is imminent and the driver has not responded adequately to warnings.

features.title: Pin dropping to navigation map
features.description: Drop a pin anywhere on the map to navigate to an arbitrary coordinate—not only searched addresses or POIs.

features.title: Launch mode
features.description: Performance Launch Mode optimizes powertrain prep for maximum acceleration launches (preconditions motors/battery as applicable) on supported dual-motor Performance cars.

features.title: Clock widget
features.description: Adds an always-visible clock widget on the display so time is easy to see without opening another app.

features.title: RWD Torque sleep
features.description: On dual-motor cars, can reduce or idle rear-motor torque in light-load situations to improve efficiency (often discussed as rear-motor “torque sleep”).

features.title: Perpendicular autopark
features.description: Expands Autopark beyond parallel spaces to perpendicular (head-in/back-in) parking stalls using Autopilot ultrasonics and cameras.

features.title: Homelink Auto open/close
features.description: Automatically opens or closes a programmed HomeLink garage door based on arrival/departure (and can pair with Summon’s Auto HomeLink setting).

features.title: Auto brightness to display
features.description: Automatically adjusts center-display brightness for ambient light so the screen stays readable day and night without constant manual tweaks.

features.title: Supercharger availability
features.description: Shows real-time Supercharger stall availability and site status (including temporary closures) on map pins so you can pick an open site before you arrive.

features.title: Spotify music service
features.description: Adds Spotify as an in-car streaming service (introduced as Rdio’s replacement), with account sign-in and playback through the cabin media UI.

features.title: Summon to ap1 cars
features.description: Summon (Beta) lets you move the car forward/back into a parking space from outside using the key fob (within a limited distance), useful for tight garages—available on Autopilot-equipped cars of that era.

features.title: Supercharger amenities
features.description: Displays amenity information for Supercharger sites (restrooms, dining, Wi‑Fi, etc.) on the map so stops can be planned around more than just stalls.

features.title: Automatic driver profiles based on key fobs
features.description: Automatically selects the driver profile associated with the key fob that unlocked/approached the car, restoring seat and preference settings without a manual profile tap.

features.title: 2 car visibility to cars with AP
features.description: Improves Autopilot driving visualization to show additional surrounding vehicles (deeper traffic context ahead/adjacent) on the instrument cluster.

features.title: Ability to name trip meter
features.description: Lets you assign custom names to trip meters (beyond Trip A/B) so energy/distance logs are easier to track per journey.

features.title: Swipe abilities in navigation
features.description: Adds swipe gestures on the navigation UI for faster interaction with the map and trip panels (for example dismissing or switching panels).

features.title: Cabin overheat protection (cools the cabin if past 40C)
features.description: Automatically ventilates or cools the cabin if interior temperature exceeds a high threshold (about 40°C / 105°F) while parked, helping protect occupants, pets, and interior materials.

features.title: Homelink audio tone
features.description: Plays an audible confirmation tone when HomeLink transmits, so you know the garage/gate command was sent without watching the UI.

features.title: Projected and rated range
features.description: Shows both projected range (based on recent driving efficiency) and rated range (EPA/WLTP estimate) so drivers can compare real-world consumption against the official rating on the instrument cluster and energy displays.
